title: Episode format
explanation: An episode is a reviewable unit with a goal and acceptance; its shape is fact-shaped. The required sections are GOAL and ACCEPTANCE; the branch must be llm/episode-<number>. The facts come from the episode extractor.

cases.original: Every episode must contain these sections in order:
cases.note: The rule requires the two mandatory sections; the optional ones are listed but not enforced.
cases.suggestion: Mark which sections are mandatory in one sentence.

cases.note: The branch must match llm/episode-<number>; a concrete number is the extractor's job, not the rule's.
cases.suggestion: State the branch pattern once, as a literal, in the template.
